title: Adding a new product type
purpose: Show new category changes the abstract contract and every concrete factory.
alt: Slider 타입 추가로 GUIFactory와 세 구체 팩토리 전체에 발생하는 변경
requiredChecks: GUIFactory adds createSlider(): Slider as new product category.
MotifFactory, WinXPFactory, MacFactory all add createSlider() returning matching MotifSlider/WinXPSlider/MacSlider.
Existing Button/TextBox/ScrollBar categories remain; no additional factory family is confused with new product type.
Caption states interface and all concrete factories change, without claiming impossible.
prompt: Create a NEW original English raster technical diagram for a design-pattern study blog. White background, navy large sans-serif labels, flat blue and teal cards, spacious connectors, no copied slide layout or logos. Monospaced class/method identifiers. Distinguish uses, implements and creates via labels on directional connectors. Title "Adding a new product type". TOP GUIFactory card lists Existing createButton(), createTextBox(), createScrollBar(); highlight NEW "+ createSlider(): Slider". Fanout three arrows down labelled must implement to MotifFactory, WinXPFactory, MacFactory cards. Each highlights createSlider() then downward returns arrow to matching MotifSlider, WinXPSlider, MacSlider respectively. Subtitle "New product category: Slider". Footer "Change the interface and every concrete factory". Amber accent only for new method, blue/teal base. No new factory family; no statement that extension is impossible. All three factories visibly changed.
